blocks.text: All licensees approved by the Director to participate in the CCA shall at all times comply with all City ordinances, State and Federal laws regulating the purchase, sale and consumption of alcoholic liquor and cereal malt beverage. (Ord. 20474 § 10, 12-19-23.)
